blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Sen. Loren Legarda has renewed her push for the full restitution and proper allocation of funds “legally intended” for the Philippine Deposit Insurance Corporation (PDIC) and the Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth). The call comes as Congress deliberates on the proposed P7.2-trillion budget for 2027. “Our national budget must reflect our responsibility to protect the health and financial security of Filipinos,” Legarda said in a recent press release. “Funds intended for healthcare and deposit insurance must be preserved and properly allocated. These are obligations we must uphold to maintain public trust in our institutions,” she noted. Legarda lamented that only […]...
